description: The onboard block in claude-code-tether/hooks/run-prepare.js caps the headless tether-onboard pass at 2400s; evals/margin/eval-configs/onboard-smoke.toml sets instance_timeout_seconds=5400 so the onboarding cap leaves the SWE task room (per evals/margin/CLAUDE.md). These two timeouts must keep their gap: raising the onboard cap toward or above the instance timeout would let onboarding consume the whole budget and the SWE task would be killed.
